name: idct
expr: rt_v = idct(dct(x)); rt_M = idct(dct(M)); rt_n6 = idct(dct(x, 6), 6); y_M_dim2 = idct(dct(M, 4, 2), 4, 2);
comment: Sig: y = idct(X[, n[, dim]]). Inverse DCT-II. Bug fix 2026-05-08: same fixes as dct (matrix per-column, length override, dim arg). Round-trip identity idct(dct(X)) == X covers all paths.
